Perfect place and good job. My little dog Nina is very happy here. Thank you so much!!
Always good service

Great service all around!  I have been coming here for a couple years and the staff has always been so friendly and full of smiles!  They are a great team from the front to back!  Will keep coming back!
Very good service 🐕‍🦺🐕🐱🐶 …

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I had a wonderful experience with Alex Grooming! They did an amazing job with my little pup. He came out looking absolutely adorable, fluffy, clean, and beautifully groomed. You can tell they really care about the pets they work with and pay attention to every detail. He looked so happy afterward too! I’m very pleased with the service and will definitely be coming back. Highly recommend Alex Grooming! 🐾❤️
Excellent service 👌 …
My little dogs made me look so beautiful
I was very happy with the service. My 2 pups/dogs seemed to be happy as well. They looked completely different. The price was good I will definitely be back  again. thank you Gracias
Very friendly and good service

This was my first time getting my cats haircut. They did an amazing job grooming Charlie! They were so kind and went above and beyond with service! The lions cut they gave him looks amazing! 10/10 would recommend

I found Alex Grooming after an appt with Petco fell through at the last minute. Alex could take Eli immediately. Eli got his spa day today and when he came out he was rejuvenated, much cleaner and bouncing. The price was comparable to other groomer's I have used for Eli. Alex will be our regular groomer going forward.
They treat the dogs very well and the service is excellent, thank you ♥️
Great job on both doggys

This place gets it done and is happy to work with you. I would recommend being very detailed and having photos so they know exactly what you want. It’s the best price in LA. Don’t pay extra if you don’t have to. Highly recommend.

Today I took my dog ​​to get a bath and haircut. They gave him back to me still a little damp, and the haircut was awful. They changed staff because other times they do a great job, but this time they messed it up. I hope the owner sees this post and hires someone better for haircuts.
I always leave here happy because they do an excellent job with everything. They are kind, respectful, and clean. Thank you, Daniel! Look no further, come here. They even cut my nails!

I'm giving them this rating because of the poor service. I took my dog ​​in for a haircut, but they didn't cut any of the hair on his face. When I went back to pick him up, he was still wet. They quoted me one price, but when I went to get him, they charged me another, claiming he wouldn't let them. So they lost a customer.
Was very careful handling my cat to the point that my cat did not show any aggresiveness.  I am very happy.  Will bring my dog next.
Had a great experience with them. They did a great job with my Pomeranian, and he came out super excited and completely untraumatized - he was trying to go back for more pets. Definitely going back!

Terrible experience. Today, May 21st, I took my babies for a haircut, and they returned my daughter to me like this. When I called to ask what happened, they completely acted like they didn't know anything and even accused me of not wanting to pay for the service, even though I had already paid. The woman who greets you and takes the money even started saying a lot of nonsense, like that a flea caused it... that's literally what she said. She also insinuated crazy things, like that I wanted the man to hit her, and I don't even know which man she was talking about or why she would say something like that when the issue was my daughter's eye. She claimed I was upset because I expressed my disagreement with them charging $25 more than agreed upon for each dog, but that has nothing to do with my daughter's eye because even though I told them it wasn't what they had charged, I still paid without any problem. These people not only didn't take responsibility for the damage caused to my daughter, but I also had to listen to a lot of nonsense during the conversation. Please. Please DO NOT bring your children here; avoid what happened to me today.
Excellent service, it was our first time visiting and my wife really liked our Luna's haircut, thank you.

This is the best groomer in LA.
They groom my dogs Freddie & Mishka.
Family owned.
It was a great place my new dog looks great
Wonderful experience. Great place for any type of grooming we are so happy to have found this place to make it our new grooming location for our two pugs. Thank you so much

We signed our cat up for a wash & cut, as well as a tooth brushing session. The cut itself surpassed the projected turnaround time of 2 hours, and when we picked her up 4 hours later she was cut but didn’t have her teeth brushed. The employees said they could do it very quickly and gave her back to us drooling after maybe 60 seconds in the back room. Overall she got everything that we wanted done for a reasonable price, but we did have to take initiative and call to check for updates on the service delays.
Alex has been doing my dog’s grooming for at least 5 years and he’s really good with her and pretty affordable. Definitely recommend!

They're providing terrible service. I sent my dog ​​to my brother's; I'd always taken her there and liked the way they groomed her, but this time they did a terrible job. Her haircut was a disaster, they didn't bathe her, even though we paid for the full service. She came out shedding a lot of the hair they cut, and all they wanted to do was make excuses. They've lost a customer, and I don't recommend them at all.

I took my dog ​​first time my dog ​​was fine I took we Alex for grooming on day 4/10/24, it turned out worse and sad. Knowing that you are not careful with the puppies, I called the owner and she told me she was going to check the video. …
Very good job and reasonable prices. Friendly staff.
